# Scribe AI

> Scribe AI turns lectures, recordings, YouTube links, and uploaded PDFs into AI-generated study notes, flashcards, quizzes, and podcasts.

## What it does

- Capture: record lectures, paste a YouTube link, or upload a PDF/document.
- Process: AI transcribes and organizes the content.
- Study: review AI-generated smart notes and outlines, auto-generated flashcards for spaced repetition, AI-written quizzes, and AI-narrated podcasts of your notes.

## Who it's for

Students, professionals, learners, and researchers.
